fusions.name: Needles in the Shoal
fusions.desc: Spits 3 venom needles in a spread; each deals 4 poison damage to the first enemy it meets and has a 30% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Silver Dart
fusions.desc: Looses a darting fang that deals 8 poison damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Shed and Slip Away
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you, and your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Venom in Every Miss
fusions.desc: Every blow you avoid builds a stack of venom on you, up to 5. Your next ability spends them all: a venom strike hits the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (170% at full). Unfed, the stacks fade.
